items.title: Actress Tamara Mello of ‘She’s All That’ puts L.A. home on the market for $1.5 million
items.description: “She’s All That” star Tamara Mello and her husband, Emmy Award-winning TV editor Paolo Cascardo, are selling their thoughtfully restored L.A. home as they prepare to relocate to Florida.

items.title: Lenovo profits soar past expectations on AI computers, servers and services
items.description: Lenovo Group on Thursday became the latest company in the build-out of artificial intelligence to report soaring profits that caught investors by surprise.

items.title: Cisco sees record results from an AI ‘supercycle,’ but its stock pulls back
items.description: An 18% revenue surge and blowout 2027 forecast weren’t enough to sustain Cisco’s stock momentum.

items.title: My wife can claim $900 at 62. Should she take it now — or wait for her spousal benefit?
items.description: “She was a teacher at a school district, so didn’t put much into Social Security.”

items.title: I found a $100 bill in the communal washer at my Airbnb. What should I do?
items.description: “The landlord has not been here in months, so I assume it was a previous tenant.”

items.title: ‘The market is obviously on fire’: Should I take $1,000 from my brokerage account to pay off my car loan?
Is $1 million enough for a household to retire? The answer keeps changing.
items.description: “Some readers — and couples — would be grateful to retire on half that amount.”

items.title: China’s next economic ambition: workshop for the Muslim world
items.description: Chinese exporters are moving into halal food, cosmetics and fashion, but success in this vast market depends on something harder to manufacture than cheap goods: trust.

items.title: Nebius adds to the excitement around neocloud stocks with upbeat earnings of its own
items.description: Investors are reacting positively to earnings results and demand signals from neocloud companies CoreWeave and Nebius.

items.title: Lumentum’s stock surges, giving a further boost to the optical-networking trade
items.description: Excitement is building for Coherent’s earnings report after upbeat results from Lumentum.
